spans.s:
mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं)
Regretting, bewailing, grieving.
E.
स with, उत्कण्ठा sorrow.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Excessive, much, violent.
m. (-सः)
A horse-laugh.
mn. (-सः-सं)
Irony, sneering praise and covert censure.
E.
स with, उत्प्रास excess or effort; it is also read सोत्प्राश.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Vigorous, energetic, persevering.
E.
स with, उत्साह effort.
